q6_slipping_through_cracks.curator_notes: Every entry pairs a real consequence with a burial factor: a bounce, an attachment, a quoted block, an auto-responder, an unresolvable pronoun, or a nine-message thread. The method was to cross-reference sends against bounces, asks against answers and promises against deliveries, then report the unmatched edges. Ridgefield #10412 appears here rather than only in Q4 because the burial is structural — three other Ridgefield invoice threads, two of them recently answered by Marta, make the account look resolved. The Jun 26 mailbox-full bounce to Marta is excluded as the deliberate contrast case: a bounce that stranded nothing. Gordon's bcc'd note to Owen is included as the misdirected-visibility case: it carries no ask, but Evelyn is invisible on a side channel into the account she owns.
